name: Coverage-based Opacity Mapping
definition: A method to convert accumulated unnormalized Gaussian weight $W_k$ into per-layer coverage opacity $ eta_k$, replacing threshold-based clamping with a smooth, monotonically increasing mapping based on the partition-of-unity assumption.
summary: Coverage-based Opacity Mapping converts Gaussian weights to per-layer opacities, replacing threshold clamping with smooth transitions to eliminate jagged edges in surface splatting.
